_about: The house's own ring images, not Shopify's: AI renders (Nano Banana) of the shop's DSC photographs, padded onto white at 1500px — from iCloud heroes-white-1500 (179 files, see its _REVIEW.txt). heroes: an image put first on a Shopify piece (by handle). pieces: rings known only from these images, no price (Price on request); name, collection, plating and stones were read off the image on 2026-09-23 and may be corrected. also: more images of the same piece; photoPlating: which plating an image shows. held: images deliberately not shown, with the reason. Originals live on the server at /catalog-src/local/<id>.png (never in git). Bangles and bracelets (ids bb-NNN.jpg, 2026-09-23): the photographs in ~/Downloads/House of Mina — Bangles & Bracelets 3.pdf, extracted by their No.; story is that catalogue's description. Its 22 pieces already on Shopify are not repeated, and its 25 Taheri photographs (green-backdrop shoots, 'new — Taheri' in the item list) are held. Shopify drafts (data/shopify-drafts.json, 2026-09-23): 31 of them are the same pieces as renders here; those renders are now the drafts' lead images (heroes) and the guessed pieces are gone. Gents' natural ruby rings (ids DSC075NN-v2.jpg, 2026-09-23): the owner's own photographs (Sony RAW, ~/Downloads/New Folder With Items 3), the whole frame (1333×2000, portrait), brightened (shadows and midtones lifted, the warm cast eased) because the owner found them too dark; the first, square crops (DSC075NN.jpg) are no longer used; 13 rings, each its own stone, named Natural Ruby Ring No. 1–13 in shoot order (short enough that the number shows on a desktop card). They are set with natural rubies (the owner's words), so `natural: true` keeps their text as written, with no 'simulated'. Sets from Instagram posts (ids PHOTO-2026-….jpg, 1080px, 2026-09-23): the three not already on the site; four more from the same batch were here already (Ruby Line, Pavé Fan Bridal, Aqua Bloom, Sapphire Two-Row) and are not repeated.
